math_steps.explanation:
$$\begin{gathered}f\left(x+y\right)=f\left(x\right)+f\left(y\right)\\f\left(u+v\right)=f\left(u\right)+f\left(v\right)\end{gathered}$$

$$\begin{gathered}u=x_{1},\ v=- x_{1} + x_{2}\\f\left(x_{2}\right)=f\left(x_{1}\right)+f\left(- x_{1} + x_{2}\right)\end{gathered}$$

$$\begin{gathered}f\left(x_{2}\right)=f\left(x_{1}\right)+f\left(- x_{1} + x_{2}\right)\\f\left(x_{2}\right)-f\left(x_{1}\right)=f\left(- x_{1} + x_{2}\right)\end{gathered}$$
